description: UVI is Akatsuki’s ultraviolet imager, mapping sunlight reflected by Venusian clouds through 283- and 365-nm filters to study sulphur dioxide and the unidentified ultraviolet absorber. Its filter wheel also carries a diffuser.
short_description: Akatsuki UVI ultraviolet imager 283 and 365 nm filters, diffuser
facility_description: Akatsuki, also called the Venus Climate Orbiter or PLANET-C, is JAXA’s Venus mission for studying the planet’s atmosphere using cameras at several wavelengths and radio occultation.
